purpose: Official Australian document links for the products named in the source calculators. Links are reference resources; they do not change the packaged workbook rules or establish project suitability.

steel_intumescent.title: FIRETEX FX5090 — FC20571/01/C1, 8 April 2025
steel_intumescent.reference_coverage: Tables 1–40. I/H three-sided beams and four-sided columns/beams; RHS/SHS three-sided beams; fully exposed hollow columns and RHS/SHS four-sided beams. Published periods vary by member case, through 180 minutes for I/H cases.
steel_intumescent.notes: Thickness is intumescent only. Three-sided beams require concrete slab contact. Four-sided beam caps: I/H 5.282 mm; RHS/SHS 5.180 mm. Exact printed temperatures only; no extrapolation or filling unavailable cells. Table 23 prints 0.192 mm despite the cover's 0.201 mm beam minimum; the table value is retained. Referenced full assessment: FC20571-01-1.

steel_intumescent.title: FIRETEX FX6010 — FC21221-01-1-C1, 31 October 2025
steel_intumescent.reference_coverage: Tables 1–46. I/H beams/columns, RHS/SHS beams/columns and CHS columns. Case-specific periods include 20, 75 and 105 minutes; 150 minutes is tabulated for I/H columns.
steel_intumescent.notes: Three-sided beams require concrete slab contact. Four-sided beam caps: I/H 5.770 mm and factor 400 m⁻¹; RHS/SHS 5.661 mm and factor 350 m⁻¹. Exact printed temperatures only. FX6010 has two components per PC115; the project owner confirmed on 24 October 2026 that the certificate's three-component wording is a typo. Original certificate and tables are retained. Referenced full assessment: FC21221-01-1.

steel_intumescent.title: FIRETEX FX5090 — Australian Product Data Sheet, PC112 January 2026
steel_intumescent.reference_coverage: Single component; 69% volume solids; 18 L pack; 1.39 kg/L transport weight used only as an editable mass estimate.
steel_intumescent.notes: Product quantities remain separate from the supplied certificate thickness tables. Confirm delivered product and application losses.

steel_intumescent.title: FIRETEX FX6010 — Australian Product Data Sheet, PC115 March 2026
steel_intumescent.reference_coverage: Two components; 18 L kit; A:B 71:1 by volume; 92% volume solids. Published theoretical spreading rate is 0.92 m²/L at 1000 µm DFT.
steel_intumescent.notes: Missing or blank FX6010 kit settings automatically use Australian 18 L / 92% defaults. Nominal mass and density estimates are derived from the linked AU SDS component volumes and typical specific gravities, not the PDS transport average. Saved numeric custom values and raw saved maps are retained. DFT still comes only from the supplied certificate tables.

steel_intumescent.title: FIRETEX FX6010 — Australian Part A Safety Data Sheet
steel_intumescent.kind: Safety data sheet — nominal pack identification
steel_intumescent.reference_coverage: Part A code 783-H0379; nominal 17.75 L pack. Section 9, page 5: typical specific gravity 1.46. SDS issued 10 August 2023, version 1.1.
steel_intumescent.notes: Nominal Part A mass estimate: 17.75 L × 1.46 = 25.915 kg, treating specific gravity numerically as kg/L for estimating. This is derived from typical SDS properties, not an exact batch fill mass.

steel_intumescent.title: FIRETEX FX6010 — Australian Part B Safety Data Sheet
steel_intumescent.kind: Safety data sheet — nominal pack identification
steel_intumescent.reference_coverage: Part B catalyst code 976-H0393; nominal 0.25 L pack. Section 9, pages 4–5: typical specific gravity 1.2. SDS issued 10 August 2023, version 1.1.
steel_intumescent.notes: Nominal Part B mass estimate: 0.25 L × 1.2 = 0.300 kg. Combined nominal mass is 26.215 kg and the mixed density estimate is 26.215 / 18 kg/L; these are derived estimates, not exact batch measurements. Mix the complete matched two-component kit; no third FX6010 component is required.

steel_intumescent.notes: Assessment uses A/V (m⁻¹). RHS/SHS mesh is required. Table limits and unavailable values are retained. The 2020 filename is not the report issue date.

PROMATECT 100 and 250 — FC15555-01-03, 13 August 2025
steel_board.reference_coverage: Tables 5–23; three-sided beams and four-sided beams/columns, including re-entrant and hollow sections; 30–180 minutes, 350–700°C, published section factors through 300 m⁻¹.
steel_board.notes: Sole thickness authority for these two products. The supplied URL filename says 01-02; its downloaded PDF identifies revision FC15555-01-03. PROMATECT 250 uses 30 mm stock; PROMATECT 100 uses 15/20 mm stock within the assessed single/double-layer construction.
